ayahs.1: Yaqeenan hum ne tujhe (hauz) Kausar (aur bahut kuch) diya hai.
ayahs.2: Pas tu apne Rabb ke liye namaz parh aur qurbani kar.
ayahs.3: Yaqeenan tera dushman hi laawaris aur be-naam-o-nishan hai.
